title: One Open Estimate Booking per Vehicle (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
**Rule.** Under Repair Estimates & Appointments, one vehicle may carry at most the estimate type's maximum number of open bookings (one, on every estimate type), where open means status booked, checked in or estimate written.

**Condition for a new booking.** The vehicle has no other booking in booked, checked-in or estimate-written status. The condition is read from the network's own booking records for that vehicle, matched by the vehicle, not from what the caller says about it.

**When the vehicle already has an open booking**, no new booking is created: a booked appointment is rescheduled, and a written estimate is revised or converted.

**What does not count.** Bookings in converted, declined, cancelled, no-show or expired status do not count.

| Status of the vehicle's other booking | Counts as open | New booking on that vehicle |
|---|---|---|
| booked | Yes | Not created; the booked appointment is rescheduled |
| checked in | Yes | Not created |
| estimate written | Yes | Not created; the written estimate is revised or converted |
| converted, declined, cancelled, no-show or expired | No | This rule does not stand in the way |

Hypothetical case: a vehicle whose only earlier booking was cancelled carries no open booking, so this rule does not prevent a new booking for it; the same vehicle with an earlier booking still in booked status carries one open booking, and no second booking is created for it.
